expectations.text: Reads the existing manifest rather than creating a new one
expectations.evidence: Baseline was given manifest context and correctly parses it. Shows phase statuses without attempting to create a new manifest.

expectations.text: Shows a status summary with cleanup and github_setup marked complete
expectations.evidence: 'Completed phases: Cleanup: done (POLICY.md, LICENSE, stale branches, README, MR merged), GitHub setup: done (repo already had content, remote added)'

expectations.text: Does NOT re-run Phase 0 or re-initialize
expectations.evidence: No Phase 0 or init section. Goes directly from status to 'Next phase: Quay OIDC Federation (Phase 3)'

expectations.text: Identifies quay_oidc as the next phase to work on
Presents guidance for the first quay_oidc item (Create Quay repo)
expectations.evidence: Phase 3 Items section lists all 7 items with curl commands and step-by-step guidance.

expectations.text: Notes that quay_repo_exists is true, suggesting the Quay repo step may be skippable
expectations.evidence: 'The manifest shows detected.quay_repo_exists: true, so this step can be skipped -- the repo at quay.io/aipcc-cicd/dashboard already exists.'
